title: Design Memory Allocator
summary: Design class Allocator(n): allocate(size, mID) returns leftmost start index of size free units or -1; freeMemory(mID) frees units and returns count.
officialConstraints: 1 <= n, size, mID <= 1000; at most 1000 calls
visualizationNotes: Operation sequence, not a single input; the full example call list was not retrieved in full.
